Interface Action

All Known Implementing Classes:
AbstractAction, ActionBarAction, ActionPipeline, BroadcastAction, BroadcastSoundAction, BroadcastWorldAction, BroadcastWorldSoundAction, ChatAction, CommandAction, ConditionalAction, ConsoleCommandAction, DelayAction, GiveExpAction, GiveMoneyAction, GivePermissionAction, MessageAction, OpenInventoryAction, PlayerCommandAction, PopInventoryAction, RandomAction, SoundAction, TakeExpAction, TakeMoneyAction, TakePermissionAction, TeleportAction, TitleAction
Functional Interface:
This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
@FunctionalInterface public interface Action
Represents an executable action within the KLibrary action engine.

Actions are the fundamental unit of work in the system. Each action receives an ExecutionContext containing the player, sender, placeholders, and metadata, and returns an ActionResult indicating the outcome.

Actions should never throw exceptions for expected failure conditions. Instead, they return ActionResult.failure(String) or ActionResult.skipped(String) to communicate the outcome to the execution pipeline.

Implementation example:

public class MyCustomAction implements Action {
    @Override
    public ActionResult execute(ExecutionContext context) {
        return context.getPlayer()
            .map(player -> {
                player.sendRichMessage("<green>Custom action!");
                return ActionResult.success();
            })
            .orElse(ActionResult.failure("No player in context"));
    }
}
